# Pinned aider-chat dependencies for supply-chain security
# This file pins exact versions to prevent supply-chain attacks during CI workflows
# Used by: ai-loop-fixer.yml
# Last updated: 2024-01-15
# Python version: 3.10+
#
# SECURITY NOTE: This tool is installed in a workflow with contents:write permission
# and has access to OPENAI_API_KEY and GITHUB_TOKEN. Exact version pinning with
# cryptographic hash verification prevents malicious package releases from executing
# arbitrary code during installation and potentially compromising credentials or the repository.
#
# To update versions:
#   1. Review the changelog and code changes for the new version
#   2. Test the new version in a non-production environment
#   3. Update the version pin below
#   4. Regenerate hashes using pip-compile:
#      pip-compile --generate-hashes --allow-unsafe --output-file=aider-requirements-lock.txt aider-requirements.txt
#
# For hash-based verification, use: pip install --require-hashes -r aider-requirements-lock.txt

# Aider - AI pair programming tool
# Pinned to specific version to prevent supply-chain attacks
aider-chat==0.42.1
